source_arch: ARM (ELF 32-bit LSB, EABI5, stripped) [seed said MIPS; binary is actually ARM]
mutation: default-true-fallthrough on session-store validation: when session_store_validate (fcn.0000c7a4) returns a negative (absent/invalid session), coerce the result to 0 (a valid AUTHORIZED_GROUP level) instead of returning the negative deny value
flaw_line: if (level < 0) level = 0;   // after level = session_store_validate(req_cb, req_buf, content_len);
why: The gate return governs the getcfg pipeline: consumer fcn.0000d760 emits AUTHORIZED_GROUP=%d and forwards the request when the return is >= 0, and replies HTTP 400 'unsupported HTTP request' when it is < 0. The original fails closed (an invalid session yields a negative -> deny). The injected line makes an invalid/absent session yield 0 (>= 0), so an unauthenticated request is treated as authorized group 0 and the getcfg request is forwarded. This is a CWE-287 authentication bypass.
